svg.title: Carnot cycle
svg.desc: A PV diagram of a Carnot cycle: isothermal expansion A to B at T_h (heat Q_h in), adiabatic expansion B to C, isothermal compression C to D at T_c (heat Q_c out), and adiabatic compression D to A. The dashed extensions are the two isotherms. Beside it, the Carnot engine: Q_h in, W out, Q_c to the cold reservoir.
